case.summary: Case HHG-007 has been adjudicated as fraud with a calibrated probability of 0.97, following an account_takeover pattern driven by suspicious identity flags showing two online transactions on a newly established identifier within a 48-hour window. Historical evidence heavily supports this conclusion, noting prior confirmed fraud cases on both this card tuple and another card held by the customer, despite a contradictory recurring cadence history and a low baseline risk decile score. Although similar prior cases like CC-1022 involved cleared alerts due to verified cardholder travel, the customer in this instance explicitly denies making the transaction. Consequently, the policy engine has triggered the necessary interventions, resulting in the card being blocked and a formal case being created.
